title: 全屏曲面 CRT：撤销左右硬切分

searched.q: css crt bezel border-radius ellipse inset box-shadow perspective rotateX
searched.takeaway: Bezel = thick border + elliptical radius + inset vignette. Mild rotateX under perspective reads as curved glass. clip-path inset(round) needs @supports fallback to radius-only.

searched.q: object-fit contain offset left canvas target mapping
searched.takeaway: Do not clip the painting. Scale the whole image (here ~70vh) then translate so its center sits left of the viewport center. Chaos homes stay in full CSS pixels.

red_lines: No WebGL / PixiJS / fragment shaders (Track A is Canvas 2D only).
No right-side fill or dark gradient mask on .paper.
